description: Define the ReqLLM v2 scenario taxonomy across text and non-text modalities so future provider-wire refactors have a documented proof matrix. This epic should identify the current fixture-backed coverage surface, mark gaps that need later epics, and add guardrails so scenario groups, model_compat capability names, and modality documentation stay aligned. Non-text modalities include vision input, file/document input, image generation, embeddings, OCR, transcription, speech, rerank, web/search/fetch tools, and media URL content parts.
title: [EPIC] Map scenario taxonomy and modality coverage gaps
